messages.author: 735a68c75081524a
messages.subject: Equivalent M2 values for different MGGUM models
parts:
Hi Dr. Chalmers,

I'm coming across an issue when calculating M2 for a couple multidimensional GGUM. Below I have code for two two-dimensional GGUM models with 16 items and 4 response options where the correct model has first 8 items going with Factor 1, the second 8 items going with Factor 2 and the inter-item correlation is set to 0. 

The `fitted.wrong` model is incorrectly specified and only has the items 9-11 loading onto Factor 2. Despite this, I get identical M2 values for both of these and I'm not sure what I might be doing wrong here. Any help you can provide would be greatly appreciated.

Thank you so much and I hope your week is off to a good start.

Ben Listyg
Doctoral Student
University of Georgia
Industrial - Organizational Psychology


set.seed(04101994)

n_items <- 16

a <- matrix(
  c(
    c(rlnorm(n = n_items/2, meanlog = .2, sdlog = .2), 
      rep(x = 0, n_items/2)),
    c(rep(x = 0, n_items/2),
      rlnorm(n = n_items/2, meanlog = .2, sdlog = .2)))
  , ncol = 2)

# a item parameters 
#           [,1]       [,2]
# [1,]  1.346210  0.0000000
# [2,]  1.037944  0.0000000

# [4,]  1.428178  0.0000000
# [5,]  1.235158  0.0000000
# [6,]  1.001862  0.0000000

# [13,] 0.000000  1.1812554
# [14,] 0.000000  1.0101210
# [15,] 0.000000  0.8884276
# [16,] 0.000000  1.5963869

b <- matrix(
  c(
    c(rnorm(n_items/2), 
      rep(x = 0, n_items/2)),
    c(rep(x = 0, n_items/2),
      rnorm(n_items/2)))
  , ncol = 2)

# b item parameters
#                             [,1]                [,2]
#  [1,] -0.40210409  0.0000000
#  [2,] -0.53300683  0.0000000

#  [4,] -0.24222561  0.0000000

# [11,]  0.00000000 -0.4204613

# [14,]  0.00000000 -1.4503028
# [15,]  0.00000000  2.3034688
# [16,]  0.00000000 -0.3217393
 
diffs <- t(apply(matrix(runif(n_items*3, .3, 1), n_items), 1, cumsum))
t <- -(diffs - rowMeans(diffs))

# t item parameters
#           [,1]        [,2]       [,3]
# [1,] 0.5412097  0.01979620 -0.5610059
# [2,] 0.4685966 -0.01663944 -0.4519572
# [3,] 0.8870089 -0.05263621 -0.8343727
# [4,] 0.7890196 -0.15519365 -0.6338259
# [5,] 0.6236097 -0.05137258 -0.5722371
# [6,] 0.7135885  0.08967588 -0.8032644
# [7,] 0.6526625 -0.01831832 -0.6343442
# [8,] 0.7690495 -0.17208532 -0.5969642
# [9,] 0.4742795 -0.06826348 -0.4060160
# [10,] 0.7344501  0.11968981 -0.8541399
# [11,] 0.4403511  0.12096530 -0.5613164
# [12,] 0.8310403  0.03678389 -0.8678241
# [13,] 0.8182477  0.07296272 -0.8912105
# [14,] 0.7023820  0.06314073 -0.7655228
# [15,] 0.9303650 -0.04642499 -0.8839400
# [16,] 0.3737697  0.06809275 -0.4418624

factor.cor <- diag(2)
factor.cor[lower.tri(factor.cor)] <- 0
factor.cor[upper.tri(factor.cor)] <- 0

fake.data <- simdata(a = a, d = b, t = t, sigma = factor.cor, N = 250, itemtype = 'ggum')

fitted.correct <- mirt(data = fake.data, 
                       model = mirt.model('F1 = 1-8\nF2 = 9-16'), 
                       itemtype = 'ggum',
                       technical=list(theta_lim=c(-3,3), NCYCLES = 10000),
                       quadpts=40,
                       optimizer="nlminb", 
                       control=list(rel.tol=1e-10,abs.tol=1e-20,iter.max=20), 
                       method = 'QMCEM',
                       TOL=1e-03,)

fitted.wrong <- mirt(data = fake.data, 
                     model = mirt.model('F1 = 1-8\nF2 = 9-11'), 
                     itemtype = 'ggum',
                     technical=list(theta_lim=c(-3,3), NCYCLES = 10000),
                     quadpts=40,
                     optimizer="nlminb", 
                     control=list(rel.tol=1e-10,abs.tol=1e-20,iter.max=20), 
                     method = 'QMCEM',
                     TOL=1e-03,)

M2(fitted.correct, QMC = T)

#             M2 df p     RMSEA  RMSEA_5  RMSEA_95     SRMSR       TLI       CFI
# stats 283.4328 24 0 0.2083565 0.186599 0.2300035 0.0991979 0.2279923 0.7426641

M2(fitted.wrong, QMC = T)
